title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 20
paragraphs: After this, the Milesians who had been taken prisoner were brought to Susa; and King Darius did them no other harm, but settled them on the sea called Erythraean, in the city of Ampe, beside which the Tigris flows on its way out to the sea. Of the Milesian land the Persians themselves kept the area around the city and the plain, but the heights they gave to the Carians of Pedasa for a possession.
